haircut.words:
You have exactly one rule for me.
Don't you dare get a haircut and i have broken it everytime.
So now there’s somebody in your life who you love the most,
and who does not listen to a word you say.
It’s me. It’s about my hair. I’m going again tomorrow.
Just kidding i dont have the balls to go bald again

days.m:
Okayy soo i cudnt resist my self from showing you howw excited i am for your birthday, i cant keep things from you, i love telling you everything its very obvious now, since only 1 month for your birthday and i cudnt keep my excitement till me i made this for youu come here everyday play a short game, get to read something. This is something small from me there's more to comee, i loveee youuuu Zahabiyaaaaaaaaa, I miss youu soo muchh you literally have zero idea, i know today u r in pain, it hurts me that i cannot be there for you take care of you hug you kiss your forehead and tuck you to sleep, but i hope this finds you and gives you a smile!

— M

days.m:
funny how some dates are just dates until someone comes along and gives them a meaning
before you 27th May was just a date
29th May was just a date
6th June was just a date
but nowww somehow i dont think ill ever look at these dates the same way again
you entered my life so unexpectedly and in such a short amount of time you made so many normal days feel sooooo special
and its not even just the big days
its the random days too
the beach days
the cold coffee mornings
the silly little moments
the funnnyyyy conversations
the days where we literally did nothing and somehow i still remember them so deeply
i loveee how i can look at a date now and immediately think of you
you didnt just become a part of my life
you became a part of my daysss ❤️

— M

days.m:
baby you know what i keep thinking about sometimes 😭❤️
how sooo many tiny little things had to go right for us to even meet properly
you joined the internship on 22nd april
i had already joined on 14th april
and we were in the same place but we still couldve easily just stayed strangers
and then there's hitesh bhai😭
he normally used to sit beside me
but he was on leave for those few days
and because he wasnt there
you ended up sitting beside meee
just think about that
if hitesh bhai chutti par na hota
you probably wouldnt have been sitting next to me
and if we werent sitting next to each other
who knows if we would've even had that first conversation
and if we didnt have that first conversation
maybe everything after that just never happens
27th may
29th may
6th june
the beach days
the letters
the cold coffees
the spiderman
all of ittt
it's actually crazy when you think about how many tiny things had to align
you had to join that internship
i had to already be there
hitesh had to be on leave
you had to end up sitting beside me
we had to actually talk
and then somehow we had to keep choosing to talk againnn
and none of us knew any of this was happening
we were literally just living our normal lives 😭
our first conversation wasnt some huge movie moment either
it was just two people talking
and somehowww that tiny little conversation became the beginning of something i now can't imagine my life without
that's what makes our story so special to me baby
it was random
it was unexpected
it was made up of a hundred tiny coincidences
and yet somehow all those little things lined up perfectly enough for us to find each other
sometimes i think about how easily we could've missed each other
and honestly that's kinda crazy
because somewhere in all those millions of little possibilities
there was one where you ended up sitting beside me
and i'm really really glad we got that one ❤️
who knew hitesh bhai going on leave would end up becoming such an important part of our love story 😭😂❤️

— M

days.m:
yesterday was kinda one of those daysss 😭❤️

i pissed you off by sleeping way too late
then somehow i managed to piss you off again by missing a meal 😭
and then we had our little serious conversation too

and somewhere in between all of that
we even had our little haircut argument 😭

i wanted to at least trim the sides and keep the top as it is
and you were basically like NOOOO
dont even touch it 😭

which is honestly very youuu
you always have an opinion about what i should and shouldnt do 😭❤️

and honestly baby
i know not every day between us is going to be perfect

sometimes i'll annoy you
sometimes you'll say something that gets to me
sometimes we'll misunderstand things
sometimes one of us will be upset and the other one won't completely understand why at first

but you know what i really really loveee about us

we talk about it

i can tell you when something hurts me
you can tell me when i've pissed you off
we can be honest about the things that make us uncomfortable
and somehow after all of thattt
we're still us ❤️

even when i don't love hearing about some things 😭
even when i get a little jealous or overthink
i know what you mean to me and i know what we are

and i trust you baby

i know who you choose
i know who you love
and i know the place i have in your hearttt ❤️

so i don't want one conversation or one little uncomfortable feeling to become bigger than everything we've built together

because there's sooo much more to us than one moment

there's all the random office jokes
our stupid little activities
hating rahul bhai together 😭
the silly conversations
the cold coffees
the beach days
the letters
the random little arguments about my hair 😭
and all those tiny things that nobody else would understand

and i think that's what i want to remember

not that we had an imperfect day

but that even on an imperfect day
i still ended it loving you exactly the sameee

you are still my favourite person to annoy 😭
still my favourite person to talk to
still the person i want to tell everything to
and still the person i'm happiest when i'm close to

so yes baby
you can continue being angry at me for sleeping late and not eating properly 😭
you can continue telling me what to do with my hair 😭
and i'll probably still annoy you tomorrow toooo

but you're still stuck with meee ❤️

— M

days.m:
yesterday was kinda tiringgg 😭

didnt get enough sleep
had errands to run
skipped lunch
and honestly the day just wasnt really going the way i wanted it to

but then i got to see youuu ❤️

and somehowww
the whole day felt a little better

i loved giving you those flowers yesterday 🥹❤️

especially because i know you dont really like real flowers
because they die
and they're expensive
and eventually they're just gone

so i wanted to make you something that actually staysss

something handmade
something that took time
something where i could actually put a little bit of me into it

they might just be paper flowers to someone else
but to me they're kinda special because i made them thinking about youuu

and seeing how much you loved them honestly made me so happy 😭❤️

even the fact that you liked how they smelled because of the perfume i sprayed on themmmm 😭

i dont know why but that made me ridiculously happy

because i loveee these tiny things about you

the way you notice little details
the way you get excited about things
the way something as simple as colouring can become something i remember and then turn into a game just for you 😭❤️

and then our call yesterdayyy

i genuinely loved talking to you

sometimes we dont even need anything special to happen
we can just sit there and talk
and somehow i still end up feeling so much better afterwards

i think thats one of my favourite things about us

you dont always have to fix my bad day
you just being a part of it somehow makes it feel less bad

yesterday started with me being tired and annoyed and running around doing random things

and it ended with me thinking about you
our flowers
our conversation
and how happy i was that i got to see youuu ❤️

so i guess thats another little thing you've quietly become for me

my bad days dont always become good days

sometimes they just become better days because i got to see you

and honestly baby
thats more than enough for meee ❤️

now go enjoy your little bouquet and remember that somewhere there is a very tired idiot who spent time making flowers for you instead of getting enough sleep 😭😂❤️

— M
